title: Create RunHeader and ComparisonHeader banner components
description:
Create two small presentational components in separate files.

**`dashboard/frontend/components/editor/RunHeader.tsx`**

Props: `relativeTime` (string), `onBackToLatest` (callback).

Renders a horizontal bar with:
- Left: "Viewing audit from {relativeTime}" in `--font-mono`, 10px, weight 400, `--color-text-tertiary`.
- Right: "← Latest" link in `--font-mono`, 10px, weight 500, `--color-accent`. On click calls `onBackToLatest`.
- Background: `var(--color-bg)`. Border-bottom: `1px solid var(--color-border)`.
- Padding: `6px 12px`.
- `role="status"`, `aria-live="polite"` on the container.
- Entry animation: opacity 0→1 + max-height 0→40px over 150ms ease. Exit: reverse in 100ms ease-in. Under reduced motion, instant.

**`dashboard/frontend/components/editor/ComparisonHeader.tsx`**

Props: `olderTime` (string), `newerTime` (string), `olderCount` (number), `newerCount` (number).

Renders a stacked layout:
- Row 1: "Comparing: {olderTime} → {newerTime}" in `--font-mono`, 11px, weight 500, `--color-text`.
- Row 2: "{olderCount} issues → {newerCount} issues" in `--font-mono`, 11px, weight 500. Delta shown as parenthesized signed integer: `(−3)` or `(+2)` or `(0)`. Color: `--color-emerald` if newerCount < olderCount, `--color-red` if greater, `--color-text-tertiary` if equal.
- Background: `var(--color-bg)`. Padding: `10px 12px`.
- `role="status"`, `aria-live="polite"`. Screen reader announcement: "Comparing audit from {olderTime} with {newerTime}. {olderCount} issues to {newerCount} issues."
- Same entry/exit animation as RunHeader.

Both components export named and default exports.
acceptance_criteria:
- [test] RunHeader renders relative timestamp text and Latest link
- [test] RunHeader Latest link uses --color-accent and calls onBackToLatest on click
- [test] RunHeader has role=status and aria-live=polite
- [test] ComparisonHeader renders both timestamps and issue counts with delta
- [test] ComparisonHeader delta uses --color-emerald when issues decreased
- [test] ComparisonHeader delta uses --color-red when issues increased
- [test] ComparisonHeader has role=status and aria-live=polite
- [lint] No hardcoded color or font values — all reference CSS custom properties
decisions: Used inline <style> blocks (scoped per component) matching the IntelPanel.tsx pattern
Used Unicode U+2212 MINUS SIGN (−) for negative delta per spec notation
Used a visually hidden sr-only span inside the live region for ComparisonHeader's screen reader announcement, keeping visual layout separate
CSS class prefixes rh- and ch- to avoid collisions with IntelPanel inline styles
concerns: Exit animation (opacity 1→0 + max-height 40px→0 over 100ms) cannot be implemented in a purely presentational component without an isExiting prop — the spec describes it but these components have no mechanism to intercept unmounting. Exit animation requires parent coordination or a library like Framer Motion.
